Gaps and implications

Your customer journey today: a big audience and a book, but no front door that leads to mentoring

1

Without a masterclass, there is no way to monetise the 95%* of your audience who aren’t ready for your mentoring yet. The free courses build goodwill, but nothing turns that goodwill into a first purchase.

2

And there is no way to find out who in your audience is actually qualified for mentoring. A follower who sends “MYTURN” and someone ready to invest look the same until you’ve spent time in the conversation.

No daily front door

New people only arrive when a post travels

46.4k people already follow you, but reach comes and goes with the algorithm. Nothing puts your message in front of new, ready people every single day.

Free, then silence

Free courses with no next step

Someone finishes a free course and loves it. Then there’s no live moment where you invite them further, so the warmest people drift off.

Inbox-led

Qualifying happens in your DMs and email

“MYTURN” and email applications work, but every conversation runs through you. That costs the exact thing you mentor people to get back: their time.

You already have the audience, the book and the message. What’s missing is one daily front door that teaches, sells the book and finds your next mentoring clients at the same time.

*The 95% figure is an industry estimate, not your data.

My recommendation

A free, always-on masterclass, fed by ads, in front of your book and your mentoring

Everything you’ve built stays. The free class becomes the front door that ads fill every day: it teaches your OmniFreedom message, offers A Reason to Rise on the thank-you page, and hands the people ready for more an application for mentoring.

Opens a front door every day

Ads put the free class in front of the right people daily, whether or not you posted that morning. Every seat joins your list, so you finally know who they are.

Turns goodwill into a first yes

People meet your book right after they’ve signed up to learn from you. The first step stays free, and A Reason to Rise becomes the easy, natural next one.

Shows who is ready for mentoring

The people who watch, stay for the Q&A and apply are the ones ready to invest. The application tells you where they are and what they want before you ever get on a call.

The 95%*

Inspired, not ready for 1:1 yet

They take the free class, many pick up your book, and everyone joins your list. Book sales help cover the ad spend while they grow toward mentoring.

The qualified 5%

Ready to invest in mentoring

They attend, stay for the Q&A and apply on the replay page. The pre-call emails prepare them, so your calls are with people who already know how you work.

*The 95% / 5% split is an industry estimate, not your data.

CTA

“The OmniFreedom Masterclass is free and live. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: Nadine counts four on her fingers, on-screen text “Mind · Heart · Time · Money”.
